disabled_all_tooltip: Downloading all episodes is disabled for this show.

match.availablePlural=one: — {announced} are announced but only {available} has been released so far.
match.availablePlural=*: — {announced} are announced but only {available} have been released so far.

hint_all_unknown: Episode count unknown — use Range to specify.
error_ffmpeg_missing_body_win32: ani-gui uses ffmpeg to save downloads as MP4, but it isn't installed on this system. The installer normally fetches it during setup — re-run the installer with an internet connection, or install ffmpeg manually.
error_ffmpeg_missing_body_linux: ani-gui uses ffmpeg to save downloads as MP4, but it isn't installed on this system. Install it via your distribution's package manager — for example `sudo apt install ffmpeg` (Debian/Ubuntu), `sudo dnf install ffmpeg` (Fedora), or `sudo pacman -S ffmpeg` (Arch).
error_ffmpeg_missing_body_darwin: ani-gui uses ffmpeg to save downloads as MP4, but it isn't installed on this system. Install it via Homebrew with `brew install ffmpeg`, or download a build manually.
status_already_here: That episode is already in this folder; keeping the existing file.
status_abandoned_claim: An interrupted download left an empty file at {path}; delete it and try again.
status_claim_pending: Another download is publishing {path} and has not finished; try again shortly.
status_repackage_retry: yt-dlp could not repackage the stream; retrying with ffmpeg.
range_error_start_over_max: The first episode can't be past {max}, the last one available.
range_error_end_over_max: The last episode can't be past {max}, the last one available.

match.maxPlural=one: You can't download more than {max} episode for this show.
match.maxPlural=*: You can't download more than {max} episodes for this show.

range_error_end_before_start: The last episode can't come before the first.
failure_timeout: The download took too long and was stopped. Try again later.
failure_write: Couldn't save the file to the download folder. Check that the folder exists, is writable and has free space.
failure_no_folder: No download folder is set. Choose one and try again.
failure_tool: The downloader stopped with an error. Try again later.
failure_tool_spawn: The downloader couldn't be started. If you installed yt-dlp or ffmpeg yourself, check that it runs; otherwise reinstall ani-gui.
